Resample a SpatRaster to daily resolution (terra version)

Source: R/component_terra.R
resample_daily_terra.Rd

Equivalent of resample_daily(). Groups layers by calendar day and applies fun, writing the result to disk chunk-by-chunk via terra::tapp() rather than holding the full input in RAM.

Usage

resample_daily_terra(r, fun = "mean", filename = "")

Arguments

r

A terra::SpatRaster with terra::time() set (sub-daily time steps expected).

fun

Aggregation function name understood by terra::tapp() (e.g. "mean", "sum", "max", "min").

filename

Optional path to write the result directly to disk (highly recommended for large jobs). Default "" (terra decides, using a temp file if the result doesn't fit in memory).

Value

A terra::SpatRaster with one layer per day.
